title: Ice party and telling a club owner he works for the people
summary: He describes a party with ice and snow and how he told a nightclub owner he plays to please the public.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Roll the truck in there. I rolled the piano in there and we rolled on up there. Now the biggest thing was getting the piano out on the ground. We got up there and they had so many waiters. They had so much help up there. And they thought that wasn't a problem. And we got ready to come home. They picked it up and put it back on the truck. Julius, do you want to rent it again? I said, well... I said, I don't know. I said, I'll find out where it's going to be. And they were so glad to get that piano. Well, my piano player played it, you know. But they said, I told them, I said, now I can give you a banjo and a ghetto. We got to have a piano. And I said, well, alright. That's what we did. Some place we played uptown, they had a... Oh, I can't think. There's so many places I played up there. They had ice. They had some people that skied, you know, on ice. And I played a big party up there for them that night. And those people had tons of ice all around on their lawn, you know. And they had snow all along the wind. That's what people got money. I mean, they didn't do so much stuff. And they, these people were from the place where they skied, you know. And they, some of them were professionals, you know. And I played a big party there one night. When I left around here, come Al Hooks. What are you doing in here? He played several numbers too. Oh, it was a daytime party there that night. And it just be so nice, just sitting there playing with those people. I mean, playing for them. Because anything you do, if somebody liked it, you got a little applause. It means a lot of street. But if you just sitting there, and you putting out everything you have. And you got a jaded audience. That's right. And just like I told a guy one night. I was playing at a nightclub. All the people was in there right there. Julius? I said, yeah. They sent the 6th or 6th or 6th or 9th. I said, well, now I want to tell you this. I said, now, I'm not working for you anymore. I said, I'm working for the people. People are not paying you. I said, yes, they are. They're paying you and they're paying me too. I said, now, I'm going to play your numbers and I'm going to play some of my numbers. All right, you want to be smart, go ahead and play. I played two numbers and there was about eight couples on the floor. I wouldn't look at him. Played about three more numbers and the whole crowd was packed like that. It's the public that you can try and... I did a cutie chime.
